A concentrated electrical discharge originates around and below the protagonist, illuminates the character edge and floor, throws particles through the stage, and becomes the composition's action/light engine.

Lightning rises from the lower focal point, character overlap establishes front-versus-back tension, arena diagonals cross the frame, and the angled headline/underline continues the attack vector toward the opponent.

The first glance reads as a premium battle-event poster: extreme scale, decisive headline, bright electrical climax, controlled dark surround, crowd silhouettes and a clear event CTA form one spectacle.
